A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FireScope and FireScope-Bench work and contain 26 pages, including supplementary material. Text and visual inspection support comparison of the equations, tables, figures and appendices without material gaps.

before.justification: v4 reports original wildfire prediction experiments, ablations and expert evaluations in Tables 1–6, plus supplementary error analyses, qualitative examples and MMMU evaluation.

after.justification: v6 retains these original experimental results, including the wildfire benchmark evaluations, expert study and supplementary MMMU results.

M1.justification: The GRPO-trained Oracle, scalar FiLM conditioning, encoder-decoder architectures and training objectives are unchanged in Sections 4 and 11. Adding 'Raster' to the title does not change the method or its outputs.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same USA risk rasters, European EFFIS and USA MTBS wildfire/control evaluations, and MMMU multiple-choice evaluation. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same AlphaEarth, SegFormer and U-Net configurations, conditioning variants, Climate MLP, FWI, GPT-5 and Qwen comparators. The larger-data and direct Qwen-decoder ablation comparators also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The splits, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations and training budgets remain unchanged. The 50-area, two-expert study and CoT perturbation/paraphrase procedures also retain their original settings.

E4.justification: Both retain the larger-data and direct-decoder ablations, interpretability studies, geographic and temporal error analyses, and supplementary case studies. Moving Table 5 does not add or revise an analysis.

E5.justification: The error bars in Figure 7 and statistical reporting around the expert study are unchanged. v6 adds no run or seed counts, confidence intervals, significance tests or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6, plotted results and qualitative examples retain the same findings and values; Table 5 is only relocated. For example, U-Net with CoT retains an OOD event ROC AUC of 0.750 in Table 1, and Section 13 retains 51.12% MMMU accuracy.

T1.justification: The reward, loss, fidelity, consistency, evaluation-metric and GRPO mathematics are unchanged in Sections 4, 5.4 and 10–11. Removing punctuation following Equation 5 does not alter its mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about reasoning-guided raster generation, cross-continental generalization and interpretability. The revised title clarifies the already established raster output without redefining the contribution.

C2.justification: Section 6 retains the interpretations concerning climate overfitting, reasoning-based conditioning and the scalar communication bottleneck. Supplementary discussions of the hyperparameter-analysis budget and retained general-purpose capabilities are also unchanged.

D1.justification: The first-page link changes from the FireScope GitHub repository to the FireScope research website, and the abstract removes 'Data and source code will be made publicly available.' This changes access information and the stated release commitment; actual resource availability cannot be established from the PDFs. Implementation details, hardware, hyperparameters and prompts remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 65 references and related-work positioning are retained. Bibliography reflow and changed citation page pointers do not add or remove prior work or revise novelty claims.

P1.justification: The main and supplementary titles add 'Raster,' Section 8 adds a Bulgarian Ministry of Education and Science funding acknowledgement, and the abstract loses its release statement. Other changes are limited to punctuation and text reflow; the narrative and section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 5 moves from above Section 9 to below its discussion on the same supplementary page. Small spacing changes reposition first-page figures and reflow opening text and references. Figure content, captions and table structures are otherwise unchanged.

improvement.justification: The scientific content and supporting evidence, including the appendices, are unchanged. The clearer title, funding acknowledgement and Table 5 placement offer small editorial benefits, while removing the release promise makes the commitment less explicit without establishing reduced resource access. These limited edits do not materially alter the paper's overall quality.
